Aliquote IVA in Spagna 2025

Le tre aliquote ufficiali regolate dall'Agenzia delle Entrate spagnola

21%

IVA General

Tipo impositivo estándar por defecto en España aplicable a la gran mayoría de bienes y prestaciones de servicios.

  • Electrónica, telefonía y tecnología
  • Ropa, calzado y textil
  • Servicios profesionales y consultoría
  • Vehículos nuevos y usados
10%

IVA Reducido

Aplicable a productos alimenticios generales, transporte de viajeros, hostelería y vivienda.

  • Alimentos para nutrición humana
  • Hostelería, bares y restaurantes
  • Transporte de pasajeros
  • Viviendas de obra nueva
4%

IVA Superreducido

Destinado exclusivamente a bienes de primera necesidad, cultura básica y salud pública.

  • Pan, leche, huevos, frutas y verduras
  • Libros, periódicos y revistas
  • Medicamentos de uso humano
  • Prótesis e implantes

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know about VAT in Spain, formulas, and invoicing

VAT (Value Added Tax, known as IVA in Spanish) is a general consumption tax assessed on the value added to goods and services. In Spain, it is regulated by the Spanish Tax Agency (Agencia Tributaria) and applies at standard rates across the supply chain.

To add VAT: Multiply the net taxable base by (1 + Tax Rate / 100). For example, €100 + 21% VAT = €100 × 1.21 = €121. To extract VAT from a gross amount: Divide the gross amount by (1 + Tax Rate / 100). For example, €121 / 1.21 = €100 taxable base.

The Equivalence Surcharge is a special mandatory VAT regime in Spain for retail traders who sell goods without manufacturing or processing them. The current surcharge rates are 5.2% on the 21% general rate, 1.4% on the 10% reduced rate, and 0.5% on the 4% super-reduced rate.

Yes, Spanish consumer protection laws require all B2C prices displayed to the public to be final gross prices with VAT included. B2B invoices between businesses and self-employed professionals must explicitly break down the net taxable base, VAT rate, and VAT quota.
